sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms of sale govern the sale of dietary supplements made by {siteName} on this site. Placing an order implies unreserved acceptance of these terms.

sections.title: 2. Products
sections.body: Our products are 100% natural dietary supplements, manufactured in GMP-certified facilities. They do not substitute for medical treatment and do not replace medical advice.

sections.title: 3. Orders
sections.body: Any order placed on the site constitutes acceptance of the prices and descriptions of the products available for sale. We reserve the right to cancel or refuse any order from a customer with whom there is a dispute.

sections.title: 4. Prices and payment
sections.body: Prices are shown in Moroccan dirhams (DH), all taxes included. Payment is made cash on delivery or by card, depending on the options offered when ordering.

sections.title: 5. Delivery
sections.body: We deliver anywhere in Morocco within 24 to 48 business hours. Timeframes are indicative and may vary depending on location.

sections.title: 6. Returns and refunds
sections.body: In line with our money-back guarantee, contact us for any return or refund request. We will find a solution suited to your situation.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms of sale, contact us at hello@biofertmaroc.com.
